module: Quality presets for dynamic vehicle captures: dynamic reflections (cubemap) and dynamic mirrors. Each function applies a level by writing the $pref::BeamNGVehicle::dynamicReflection::* or dynamicMirrors::* variables in VariableRegistry. The code comment says it restores the Normal/High/Ultra settings of 0.39.
notes: An unknown level is ignored without a message.
Available levels: Disabled, Lowest, Low, Normal, High, Ultra.

reflectionLevels.desc: Per level: enabled (boolean), textureSize (128 to 1024), facesPerUpdate (1 or 2), detail (0 to 0.75), distance (50 to 300).

mirrorLevels.desc: Per level: enabled (boolean), textureSize (128 to 1024), detail (0 to 0.75), distance (50 to 300). No facesPerUpdate.

applyReflection.desc: Applies a dynamic reflections level: writes enabled, textureSize, facesPerUpdate, detail and distance to $pref::BeamNGVehicle::dynamicReflection::*.

level.desc: Key of reflectionLevels (Disabled, Lowest, Low, Normal, High, Ultra).

applyMirrors.desc: Applies a dynamic mirrors level: writes enabled, textureSize, detail and distance to $pref::BeamNGVehicle::dynamicMirrors::*.

level.desc: Key of mirrorLevels (Disabled, Lowest, Low, Normal, High, Ultra).
